description: This file implements various executor mappers and decorators for high-level DU (Distributed Unit) task execution management, including dedicated, strand-based, and UE (User Equipment) mapping strategies, as well as control plane task handling.

classes.name: executor_decorator
classes.description: Helper class to decorate executors with additional functionalities such as tracing, metrics, and throttling.

classes.name: dedicated_cell_worker_executor_mapper
classes.description: Maps each cell to dedicated serialized worker executors, one per cell.

classes.name: strand_cell_worker_executor_mapper
classes.description: Uses a thread pool and creates one strand per cell with associated executors.

classes.name: common_ue_executor_mapper
classes.description: Base class for UE executor mappers, managing multiple strands for UEs.

classes.name: index_based_ue_executor_mapper
classes.description: Maps UEs to executors based on their RNTI (Radio Network Temporary Identifier).

classes.name: pcell_ue_executor_mapper
classes.description: Maps UEs to executors based on their serving PCell (Primary Cell).

classes.name: ctrl_executor_mapper
classes.description: Manages control-plane task execution with prioritized strands.

classes.name: du_high_executor_mapper_impl
classes.description: Main implementation class that provides cell, UE, and control executor mappings for high-level DU operations.

methods.name: create_du_high_executor_mapper
methods.description: Factory function to create a high-level DU executor mapper based on configuration.
